info.title: CoArena API
info.description: Every CoArena feature, over HTTP. Authenticate with a personal API key (Authorization: Bearer coa_…) minted on your account page; each operation names the scope it needs. Errors share one envelope, except on the Model API (/api/v1), which answers in OpenAI's or Anthropic's so their SDKs can parse it (x-coarena-envelope on each operation says which); 429 and 503 carry Retry-After. See /developers.

Error.description: Every error. `error` keeps the value each route has always sent (browser clients match on it); new clients branch on `code`.

retryAfter.description: Seconds; mirrors the Retry-After header on 429/503.

OpenAIError.description: Every Model API error on an OpenAI-shaped route. `code` is CoArena's stable code; `type` is OpenAI's class, which the OpenAI SDKs map to an exception.

AnthropicError.description: Every Model API error on an Anthropic-shaped route. `error.type` is Anthropic's class, which the Anthropic SDK maps to an exception; `error.code` is CoArena's stable code, inert to the SDK.
